# Alert Runbook

Use this runbook when an alert fires and the current impact is not yet known.

1. Identify the alert owner, affected service, severity, and start time.
2. Confirm customer impact with live metrics, logs, and traces.
3. Check recent deployments and configuration changes.
4. Apply only an approved mitigation, then verify recovery with the same signals.
5. Record the evidence, remaining risk, and follow-up actions.

This document describes a procedure. It is not evidence of the current live system state.
